name: @publicdomainrelay/market-x402
description: x402 payment layer for the com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.* protocol (companion to @publicdomainrelay/market).

comments.parent: Imports @publicdomainrelay/market by relative path (../market/mod.ts) in this monorepo. Published separately, depend on @publicdomainrelay/market instead.
comments.x402: Intentionally does NOT depend on @x402/* or any facilitator package — payment gating stays the consumer's concern. settleX402Payment accepts a `fetch` option so callers can pass an x402-paying fetch.
comments.node: Sources are TypeScript with explicit .ts import specifiers (Deno convention); load via a TS-aware loader (tsx / ts-node ESM) or a bundler/tsc that preserves .ts resolution. Runtime code uses only web-standard Request/Response/fetch plus the @atproto/* packages — no Deno.* or node:* APIs.
